items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: Because the bass player with P. Ron, I remember, was Eskader... He's a Spanish Cuban. He's a Cuban guy.

ctx.x: He played trombone with him, I think.

Well, maybe so. Yes, yes, he did. Because the bass player with P. Ron, I remember, was Eskader. Oh, yeah. Eskader. Yeah. He's a Spanish Cuban. He's a Cuban guy. Yes. Because he played bass, string bass and bass horn. And by the way, when I was with David John, and he had his band on the Astoria roof, he's the first lesson on the bass horn. He started me playing bass tuba.
I heard one rumor once that when you made those records, you were so young, you had to practically stand on a box.
